reviewer: independent read-only subagent (Explore type, fresh context, opus), one per tool; ran the tool's unit tests and read the tool, harness, fixtures and keys

findings.finding: The grader could never pass dcf-01 if the agent lists the real debug prints in cli.py: the key for decoy J07 reduced to the bare word "print".
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: symbol vs line matching rewritten: an answer entry is a symbol only if it names one (name, a.b, name(), def f(...)); line text is matched as text; keys that are single words are matched as whole words. Checked with the reviewer's failing inputs (J07, K10 vs OLD_DATE_FMT, N2).

findings.finding: Answer lines and key entries were compared the wrong way (OLD_DATE_FMT line hit decoy K10; print("took") never matched N2; short names matched anywhere).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: same rewrite; whole-word matching.

findings.finding: The grader could not handle a method of a dead class or a whole dead module (Experimental.run, PaypalBackend.charge, pluglib/compat.py).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: members of a dead class are neutral; compat module added as a neutral key item.

findings.finding: Answer keys, scan reports and the other arm's prompts were reachable from every work folder; forbid ran on A only.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: work folders moved to <home>\AppData\Local\Temp\rw (keys, harness, the JEV copy with demo gold files and the case generators stay under the scratchpad); the wrappers import a JEV copy without gold.json/run outputs/tests; the forbid check now runs on BOTH arms and also matches scratchpad, keys, hidden_test, make_*, gold.json, harness. Folders of the other arm remain reachable by path: a residual caveat listed in the manifest deviations.

findings.finding: The arm-B wrapper logged status ok even when Jev failed (the scan always prints "JEV n sent"), requests hard-coded 1, invalid hard-coded 0.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: status is ok only if at least one candidate has a Jev answer; requests parsed from the report; invalid = sent - answered.

findings.finding: dcf-03 dead items are ambiguous for a published library and 4/4 recall was required.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: recall rule is now >= 75% (rounded up); the prompt defines public API as __all__ and declared entry points.

findings.finding: Keys left out plausible items (cli.py registry prints, redundant test import, unicodedata import, the compat module).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: added as neutral items.

findings.finding: Arm B alone was told to verify its list; the shared prompt lists the decoy categories.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: verify sentence removed from B. The category list stays in both arms (a ceiling risk, noted in deviations).

findings.finding: One B folder and its log were used by the smoke run before the real runs.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: everything rebuilt after the smoke runs.

findings.finding: All-or-nothing pass rule and lenient matching.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: raw counts (dead found, decoys, unlisted, neutral) are in every observedOutcome; unlisted items are reviewed by hand.

findings.finding: dcf-01 is in-sample; the own fixtures were scanned by the tool while being built.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: stated in manifest deviations; dcf-01 is reported as in-sample; the scans only checked that the tool runs and the keys have no forgotten dead item.
